name: v0.11.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Update Nord theme to match reference implementation by @jpcirrus in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/138
* Added tokyonight-day theme by @haasal in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/141
* dracula: Update `unimportant` to match Dracula colors by @RobLoach in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/144
* style(theme): Init cyberdream theme by @byt3m4st3r in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/142
* added modus-vivendi theme by @sorend in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/148
* Add Aseprite file extensions by @RobLoach in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/145
* Vim: add .swo and .swn for swap files by @yochem in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/152
* Add file types .zpaq, .paq8o, .paq8n, .tsv by @EyeCon in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/150
* Readme: add instructions for fish by @simono in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/155
* Update CI runners to -latest versions by @rpdelaney in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/165
* Fix wrong file extension xvf -> xcf by @rpdelaney in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/164
* Update Debian package download instructions to v0.10.1 by @mattbalvin in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/167
* .csv and .tsv are spreadsheet formats, not markup by @Monty in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/175
* Fix Keynote presentation ext by @rpdelaney in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/177
* Upgrade amd64 macos runner to version 15 by @rpdelaney in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/182
* Add .mjs, .cjs javascript extensions by @Monty in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/180
* docs(readme): simplify fish usage instructions by @tranzystorekk in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/170
* Reword NoThemeProvided error by @rpdelaney in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/185
* Add `.odin` for Odin Lang by @sumit-sahrawat in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/188
* Import many file types from LS_COLORS by @rpdelaney in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/189
* Import additional categories from LS_COLORS by @rpdelaney in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/191
* Add an ANSI color theme using terminal's 16-color palette by @martenlienen in https://github.com/sharkdp/vivid/pull/190

name: v0.9.0
body:
## Changes

- Make the output order deterministic, see #63 and #87 (@tavianator)
- Added more filetypes, see #95 (@Babkock)
- Make it possible to build vivid with LTO, see #90 (@ixti)

## Themes

- Added alabaster_dark, see #91 (@p00f)
- Added catppuccin-*, see #94 (@etenzy)
- Added modus-operandi, see #96 (@apraga)
- Updates in the lava theme, see #88 (@fredericrous)
- Updates in the dracula theme, see #85 (@yavko)

name: v0.8.0
body:
## Changes

- Added new core filetypes (reset_to_normal, multi_hard_link, door, setuid, setgid), see #78 (@ixti)
- Added instructions on how to preview themes in a user-defined directory, see #75 (@WoLpH)

## New filetypes

- Opus and WavPack audio extensions, see #71 (@desbma)
- `.webm`, see #72 (@desbma)
- `.pyd`, `.pyo`, see #73 (@bl-ue)

## New themes

- Nord, see #66 (@Utagai)
- Lava, see #66 (@fredericrous)
- Iceberg, see #70 (@p00f)
- Gruvbox, see #79 (@ixti)
- Dracula, see #80 (@yavko)

name: v0.7.0
body:
- List available themes via `vivid themes`, see #48 (@gillespiecd)
- Added "One" theme, see #51 (@mortezadadgar)
- Fix panic if stdout is closed, see #56

name: v0.6.0
body:
- The default themes and config files are now embedded into the `vivid` binary.
  See #43 (@LordFlashmeow)
- Added `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` as a possible source for theme files, see #40 (@LordFlashmeow)
- Better error handling, see #43 (@LordFlashmeow)
- Added macOS category to unimportant files, see #33 (@gseidler)
- Added more media file types, see #38 (@gseidler)
- Add new core filetypes for `sticky`/`other_writable`/`sticky_other_writable`, see #34 (@mattbalvin)

name: v0.5.0
body:
- Added `jellybeans` theme, see #26 (@chandlerc)
- Added `solarized-dark` and `solarized-light` theme, see #30 (@menelaos)
- Theme arguments can be a path to a YAML theme file, see #23
- Added LLVM file types, see #27 (@chandlerc)
- Added support for block and character devices
- Added `preview` subcommand, see #13
